name: Viva Chicken (Herriman / Mountain View Corridor) Peruvian Rotisserie Chicken & White Rice
whyItWorks: Right near Holiday Inn Express Herriman, Viva Chicken slow-roasts tender Peruvian rotisserie chicken over charcoal; pairing a quarter white-meat chicken (skin removed) with cilantro-free white rice and warm chicken tortilla-free soup or ripe sweet fried plantains (maduros) is delicious and flare-friendly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Quarter White Meat Rotisserie Chicken (remove the spiced skin if sensitive) with steamed white rice and sweet plantains (maduros)—skip the spicy Huacatay/Rocoto chili sauces and lime juice.
watchOuts: Skip all three Peruvian dipping sauces (Yellow Aji, Green Huacatay, and Red Rocoto—all contain chili peppers and/or lime juice)
